name: Sarah Chen

employment.title: Analytics Engineer
employment.summary: Built and maintained ELT pipelines in dbt and SQL for global product and experimentation analytics; designed reusable metric definitions and semantic components; implemented automated data quality checks; partnered with Data Science/Experimentation on governed experiment event datasets; optimized SQL transformations for performance; developed Airflow DAGs and runbooks for ingestion/backfills; authored documentation to improve analyst onboarding.

employment.title: Data Analytics Engineer
employment.summary: Developed Python/SQL ingestion and transformation workflows orchestrated with Airflow; built dimensional models for reporting and ad-hoc analysis; created anomaly detection reports for telemetry drops/instrumentation issues; collaborated on event schema refinement with backward compatibility; improved query efficiency via indexing/partitioning; maintained data governance with access controls and standardized dataset naming.
